decisions.csharp: All 12 FunctionDeclarations emission paths use generated FunctionDefinitionPrefix, preserving define internal. CPU selected user function and async factory use it too.
decisions.slg: functions.slg ordinary definition around1293 and async factory around1090 currently print define without internal; these two sites will consume functionDefinitionPrefix. emitFunctionNamed also emits the async worker, which is private in CSharp.

decisions.csharp: Library.cs defines exported wrappers separately and calls private SymbolForFunction bodies.
decisions.slg: library_exports.slg likewise defines dllexport/protected wrapper symbols separately. Keep exported wrapper definitions unchanged; only the called user body becomes private.

decisions.csharp: Private function definition policy does not apply to external/native ABI declarations.
decisions.slg: core_prepare.slg unresolved external declarations remain declare, not internal; do not edit declarations through a blanket textual replacement.

decisions.csharp: WindowsLinker optimizes the full module to bitcode, then llvm-split partitions it. Internal linkage is already supported by the same compiler build path.
decisions.slg: Actual checked emitted LLVM will be assembled and linked, rather than proving linkage from source strings only.
